findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - A generated test group reaches its configured timeout and GitHub reports it as cancelled; its available log names no change. Forge recognizes cancellations at the time limit as timeouts in src/forge/checks.py:272-295, but the [GitHub CLI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cli/cli/trunk/pkg/cmd/pr/checks/aggregate.go) classifies `CANCELLED` as `cancel`. This guard rejects that bucket, so Forge falls back to individual checks without rerunning the failed jobs. The repair test hardcodes a `fail` bucket for its timeout case at tests/test_train_land_all.py:79 and :649, so it misses this outcome.
